summary: @or-sdk/tickets preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x identifiers with indirection wrappers) and, when Bun is not already present, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmod +x it, and then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated blob using a string-array rotation cipher (WV8StW shift function, n7gIxM mixed literal/int array, hc1jfK9 decoder over a scrambled alphabet) — the standard shape of an obfuscator-encoded loader. The package advertises itself as a tickets SDK; the dist/ SDK entry does not reference math_init.js, and nothing in the advertised purpose requires a second language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated script at install. The delivery pattern is the alternate-runtime dropper: the sibling payload is executed by a freshly fetched second runtime, bypassing Node-level inspection, so any code the payload contains runs with the installer's privileges on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
